title: Gold advances to $4,200 amid retreating USD; Fed hike bets to cap further gains
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its modest intraday move up and hits a fresh daily high around the $4,200 neighborhood during the Asian session on Tuesday. The US Dollar (USD) retreats from its highest level since April 2025 amid some profit-taking, offering support to the commodity.

title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data

title: Gold tumbles below $4,200 on higher oil prices, firmer US Dollar
summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) falls to around $4,170 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal retreats from a ‌one-week high on a stronger US Dollar (USD) and higher crude oil prices.
